name: Scale Model Engineering
description: 1:8 and 1:10 scale replicas built with precision engineering — proportions, body lines, and mechanical functions recreated at scale with thousands of Technic elements. The Ultimate sets (McLaren P1, Ferrari Daytona) deliver the most authentic scale-model experience.

name: Official Brand Partnerships
description: Officially licensed sets created in collaboration with McLaren, Ferrari, Red Bull Racing, Mercedes-AMG, Porsche, BMW, Ford, Bugatti, and Chevrolet. Authentic liveries, logos, and design approval from the real manufacturers and racing teams.

name: Working Mechanical Functions
description: Functional steering, suspension, gearboxes, engines with moving pistons, and opening doors/hoods built from Technic elements. These aren't stickers — they're real mechanical systems you assemble and operate. Premium sets feature 6+ distinct working functions.

name: LEGO Insiders Loyalty Points
description: Every Technic purchase earns LEGO Insiders points (roughly 6.5 points per dollar). Premium sets like the McLaren P1 earn 2,925 points — redeemable for discounts, exclusive sets, and VIP experiences. Members get early access to new releases.

name: Complete F1 Grid Collection
description: Build multiple F1 cars from the current grid — Red Bull, McLaren, Ferrari, and Mercedes — to create a complete Formula 1 collection. Each car at the same scale, designed to display together as a racing lineup.

name: Fast and Furious Movie Collection
description: Build iconic cars from the Fast and Furious franchise — from Dom's Dodge Charger to Brian's Skyline R34 and Eclipse. Each set captures the movie-accurate livery and modifications that made these cars legendary on screen.

name: Display-Worthy Design
description: Every Technic set is designed to look stunning on a shelf. Premium sets include display stands with nameplates. The models feature authentic proportions, color-accurate bodywork, and details visible from every angle — built to be admired, not just assembled.

name: Pneumatic Systems
description: Select Technic sets feature pneumatic-powered mechanisms — air cylinders and pumps that create smooth, realistic mechanical operation for cranes, lifts, and moving parts. A unique engineering experience not found in any other LEGO theme.

name: Entry Points at Every Budget
description: LEGO Technic motorsport sets range from $59.99 (Corvette Stingray) to $449.99 (McLaren P1 / Ferrari Daytona). Accessible sets at $65 introduce the building system; premium sets at $230 deliver F1-level detail; Ultimate sets at $450 are peak engineering.

name: Motorsport History & Heritage
description: Sets that celebrate racing history — from the 1966 Ford GT40 that won Le Mans to modern F1 championship cars. Each build tells the story of automotive engineering evolution and the legendary races that defined motorsport.
